shared_elements: upright anthropomorphic pillar/stele carved in low relief
animal shown in profile with four legs
vertical stacking of motifs on the front face of the shaft
horizontal band/belt-like element across the lower body
arm/limb element carved along the side of the shaft
justification: Both show an upright, body-like stele whose front face carries low-relief creatures stacked vertically — a profile quadruped above serpentine forms, with a belt-like horizontal band and limbs indicated on the sides — a fairly specific shared scheme of an anthropomorphic pillar bearing animal reliefs. The biggest difference in content is A's dense array of large discs/rings, a rendered head and multiple pendant snake-like strands, none of which appear in B, whose panel is dominated by a single large predator over a sparse pair of lower motifs.
